purpose: Permanent Russian-language research source routing for Biupiu Main research discovery.

sources.name: ITMO OpenBooks
sources.code_rule: Search article title/keywords, then look for linked PDF, authors, datasets, implementation references and independently available code. Do not treat a paper as executable code.

sources.name: Math-Net.Ru
sources.code_rule: Extract algorithms and numerical methods; search GitHub/CODEX for independent implementations; preserve theorem/model assumptions and validation limits.

sources.name: Institute of Control Sciences RAS (IPU RAS)
sources.code_rule: Search laboratory publications and technical reports for algorithms, simulation tools and control models; independently verify implementations before integration.

sources.name: MedSoc / Medical Sociology Online (BSA Medical Sociology Group)
sources.code_rule: Use for social/health-system context and human factors. Do not convert sociological findings into biomedical efficacy claims. Search for cited datasets, methods and open supplementary material where available.

global_search_rules: Search original Russian terminology plus English technical equivalents.
Prefer primary institutional publications and stable full-text records.
Translate before synthesis but preserve the original Russian title and source metadata.
Separate publication evidence from executable code.
For code, record repository URL, commit/tag, licence, dependencies and provenance.
For algorithms, reproduce assumptions and validation conditions before reuse.
Never silently replace an earlier implementation; version new adaptations.
Route computationally testable findings into a CODEX queue.
Run provenance/licence/security checks before importing third-party code.
Do not treat publication presence as proof that a method is validated for Biupiu use.
